    jep.Jep.isValidThread()
    For internal usage only. Internal Only
    jep.SubInterpreterOptions.setCheckMultiInterpeExtensions(boolean)
    Deprecated in Jep 4.2.1. This method is misspelled and has a typo in the name. Please use the correctly named setCheckMultiInterpExtensions. The misspelled method will be removed in Jep 4.3.
    jep.PyConfig.setDontWriteBytecodeFlag(int)
    Use #setWriteBytecode(int) instead.
    jep.PyConfig.setHashRandomizationFlag(int)
    Use PyConfig.setHashSeed(int) and #setUseHashSeed(int) instead.
    jep.PyConfig.setIgnoreEnvironmentFlag(int)
    Use #setUseEnvironment(int) instead.
    jep.PyConfig.setNoSiteFlag(int)
    Use #setSiteImport(int) instead.
    jep.PyConfig.setNoUserSiteDirectory(int)
    Use #setUserSiteDirectory(int) instead.
    jep.PyConfig.setOptimizeFlag(int)
    Use PyConfig.setOptimizationLevel(int) instead.
    jep.PyConfig.setPythonHome(String)
    Use PyConfig.setHome(String) instead.
    jep.MainInterpreter.setSharedModulesArgv(String...)
    Use PyConfig.setArgv(String...) instead.
    jep.PyConfig.setVerboseFlag(int)
    Use PyConfig.setVerbose(int) instead.
  • Deprecated Constructors 
    Constructor and Description
    jep.Jep()
    Deprecated in 3.9. Use SubInterpreter or SharedInterpreter instead. If you used Jep objects in previous releases, use SubIntepreter for the same behavior.
    jep.Jep(JepConfig)
    Deprecated in 3.9. Use SubInterpreter or SharedInterpreter instead. If you used Jep objects in previous releases, use SubIntepreter for the same behavior.
    jep.PyConfig()
    Use PyConfig.python() or PyConfig.isolated instead.
